requirements.quote: The Server MUST NOT match Topic Filters starting with a wildcard character (# or +) with Topic Names beginning with a $ character [MQTT-4.7.2-1]. The Server SHOULD prevent Clients from using such Topic Names to exchange messages with other Clients. Server implementations MAY use Topic Names that start with a leading $ character for other purposes.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter starts with # and a Topic Name starts with $
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server MUST NOT match the filter to the Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: A # subscription and $-prefixed publication can be created and delivery checked for absence.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST NOT match Topic Filters starting with a wildcard character (# or +) with Topic Names beginning with a $ character [MQTT-4.7.2-1]. The Server SHOULD prevent Clients from using such Topic Names to exchange messages with other Clients. Server implementations MAY use Topic Names that start with a leading $ character for other purposes.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter starts with + and a Topic Name starts with $
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server MUST NOT match the filter to the Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: A +-prefixed subscription and $-prefixed publication can be created and delivery checked for absence.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST NOT match Topic Filters starting with a wildcard character (# or +) with Topic Names beginning with a $ character [MQTT-4.7.2-1]. The Server SHOULD prevent Clients from using such Topic Names to exchange messages with other Clients. Server implementations MAY use Topic Names that start with a leading $ character for other purposes.
requirements.condition: When Clients attempt to use $-prefixed Topic Names to exchange messages with other Clients
requirements.required_behavior: The Server should prevent that Client-to-Client exchange.
requirements.why_checkable: Two Clients can attempt publication and subscription under a $-prefixed Topic Name and delivery can be observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST NOT match Topic Filters starting with a wildcard character (# or +) with Topic Names beginning with a $ character [MQTT-4.7.2-1]. The Server SHOULD prevent Clients from using such Topic Names to exchange messages with other Clients. Server implementations MAY use Topic Names that start with a leading $ character for other purposes.
requirements.condition: For Topic Names beginning with $
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to use them for other, Server-defined purposes.
requirements.why_checkable: MAY grants optional use without imposing a required Server behavior or defining the other purposes.

requirements.quote: All Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST be at least one character long [MQTT-4.7.3-1]
requirements.condition: For every Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: Use a length of at least one character.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: An empty Topic Name is forbidden.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded character count can be checked against the lower bound of one.

requirements.quote: All Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST be at least one character long [MQTT-4.7.3-1]
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: Use a length of at least one character.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: An empty Topic Filter is forbidden.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded character count can be checked against the lower bound of one.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters are case sensitive
requirements.condition: When comparing or identifying Topic Names
requirements.required_behavior: Treat character case as significant.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not fold upper and lower case together.
requirements.why_checkable: Names differing only by letter case can be tested as distinct.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters are case sensitive
requirements.condition: When matching Topic Filters
requirements.required_behavior: Treat character case as significant.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not case-fold filter characters or Topic Name characters.
requirements.why_checkable: A filter and name differing only by case can be tested for non-match.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters can include the space character
requirements.condition: For a Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the space character.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not reject a Topic Name solely because it contains a space.
requirements.why_checkable: A valid UTF-8 Topic Name containing U+0020 can be submitted.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters can include the space character
requirements.condition: For a Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: Allow the space character.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not reject a Topic Filter solely because it contains a space.
requirements.why_checkable: A valid UTF-8 Topic Filter containing U+0020 can be submitted.

requirements.quote: A leading or trailing ‘/’ creates a distinct Topic Name or Topic Filter
requirements.condition: When two Topic Names differ only by a leading /
requirements.required_behavior: Treat them as distinct Topic Names.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not normalize away the leading separator.
requirements.why_checkable: Subscriptions/publications using the two names can be checked for separate routing.

requirements.quote: A leading or trailing ‘/’ creates a distinct Topic Name or Topic Filter
requirements.condition: When two Topic Names differ only by a trailing /
requirements.required_behavior: Treat them as distinct Topic Names.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not normalize away the trailing separator.
requirements.why_checkable: Subscriptions/publications using the two names can be checked for separate routing.

requirements.quote: A leading or trailing ‘/’ creates a distinct Topic Name or Topic Filter
requirements.condition: When two Topic Filters differ only by a leading /
requirements.required_behavior: Treat them as distinct Topic Filters.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not normalize away the leading separator.
requirements.why_checkable: The two subscriptions can be stored and matched independently.

requirements.quote: A leading or trailing ‘/’ creates a distinct Topic Name or Topic Filter
requirements.condition: When two Topic Filters differ only by a trailing /
requirements.required_behavior: Treat them as distinct Topic Filters.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not normalize away the trailing separator.
requirements.why_checkable: The two subscriptions can be stored and matched independently.

requirements.quote: A Topic Name or Topic Filter consisting only of the ‘/’ character is valid
requirements.condition: When a Topic Name consists only of /
requirements.required_behavior: Accept it as valid.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not reject it solely for having no non-separator character.
requirements.why_checkable: The single-character name can be submitted as a boundary case.

requirements.quote: A Topic Name or Topic Filter consisting only of the ‘/’ character is valid
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter consists only of /
requirements.required_behavior: Accept it as valid.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not reject it solely for having no non-separator character.
requirements.why_checkable: The single-character filter can be submitted as a boundary case.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST NOT include the null character (Unicode U+0000) [Unicode] [MQTT-4.7.3-2]
requirements.condition: For every Topic Name
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Topic Name MUST NOT include Unicode U+0000.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded name can be scanned for the null code point.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters MUST NOT include the null character (Unicode U+0000) [Unicode] [MQTT-4.7.3-2]
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Topic Filter MUST NOT include Unicode U+0000.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded filter can be scanned for the null code point.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes [MQTT-4.7.3-3]. See Section 1.5.3
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: Use an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use arbitrary binary data or another string encoding.
requirements.why_checkable: The Topic Name bytes can be validated against MQTT UTF-8 rules.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes [MQTT-4.7.3-3]. See Section 1.5.3
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: Use an MQTT UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not use arbitrary binary data or another string encoding.
requirements.why_checkable: The Topic Filter bytes can be validated against MQTT UTF-8 rules.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes [MQTT-4.7.3-3]. See Section 1.5.3
requirements.condition: For every Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: Keep its UTF-8 encoding at or below 65535 bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode a Topic Name longer than 65535 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded byte length can be counted and checked at the boundary.

requirements.quote: Topic Names and Topic Filters are UTF-8 encoded strings, they MUST NOT encode to more than 65535 bytes [MQTT-4.7.3-3]. See Section 1.5.3
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: Keep its UTF-8 encoding at or below 65535 bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not encode a Topic Filter longer than 65535 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded byte length can be counted and checked at the boundary.

requirements.quote: There is no limit to the number of levels in a Topic Name or Topic Filter, other than that imposed by the overall length of a UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.condition: For a Topic Name whose total UTF-8 encoding is within the permitted string length
requirements.required_behavior: Accept any number of topic levels representable within that length.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not impose a separate lower maximum level count.
requirements.why_checkable: Names with increasing separator counts but valid total byte length can be submitted.

requirements.quote: There is no limit to the number of levels in a Topic Name or Topic Filter, other than that imposed by the overall length of a UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.condition: For a Topic Filter whose total UTF-8 encoding is within the permitted string length
requirements.required_behavior: Accept any number of filter levels representable within that length.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not impose a separate lower maximum level count.
requirements.why_checkable: Filters with increasing separator counts but valid total byte length can be submitted.

requirements.quote: When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters [MQTT-4.7.3-4]. Each non-wildcarded level in the Topic Filter has to match the corresponding level in the Topic Name character for character for the match to succeed.
requirements.condition: When the Server performs subscription matching
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not normalize Topic Names.
requirements.why_checkable: A Topic Name whose normalized form differs can be tested against the literal filter.

requirements.quote: When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters [MQTT-4.7.3-4]. Each non-wildcarded level in the Topic Filter has to match the corresponding level in the Topic Name character for character for the match to succeed.
requirements.condition: When the Server performs subscription matching
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not normalize Topic Filters.
requirements.why_checkable: A Topic Filter whose normalized form differs can be tested against the literal Topic Name.

requirements.quote: When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters [MQTT-4.7.3-4]. Each non-wildcarded level in the Topic Filter has to match the corresponding level in the Topic Name character for character for the match to succeed.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Name contains an unrecognized character during subscription matching
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not modify that character.
requirements.why_checkable: The match result can be tested with literal unrecognized characters.

requirements.quote: When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters [MQTT-4.7.3-4]. Each non-wildcarded level in the Topic Filter has to match the corresponding level in the Topic Name character for character for the match to succeed.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter contains an unrecognized character during subscription matching
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not modify that character.
requirements.why_checkable: The stored filter and match result can be checked for literal preservation.

requirements.quote: When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters [MQTT-4.7.3-4]. Each non-wildcarded level in the Topic Filter has to match the corresponding level in the Topic Name character for character for the match to succeed.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Name contains an unrecognized character during subscription matching
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not substitute another character for it.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can distinguish literal matching from replacement-character matching.

requirements.quote: When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters [MQTT-4.7.3-4]. Each non-wildcarded level in the Topic Filter has to match the corresponding level in the Topic Name character for character for the match to succeed.
requirements.condition: When a Topic Filter contains an unrecognized character during subscription matching
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not substitute another character for it.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can distinguish literal matching from replacement-character matching.

requirements.quote: When it performs subscription matching the Server MUST NOT perform any normalization of Topic Names or Topic Filters, or any modification or substitution of unrecognized characters [MQTT-4.7.3-4]. Each non-wildcarded level in the Topic Filter has to match the corresponding level in the Topic Name character for character for the match to succeed.
requirements.condition: For each non-wildcarded Topic Filter level during matching
requirements.required_behavior: Require character-for-character equality with the corresponding Topic Name level for the match to succeed.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not declare a match when a non-wildcarded corresponding level differs.
requirements.why_checkable: Level-aligned literal strings can be varied by one character and the match result observed.

requirements.quote: An Application Message is sent to each Client Subscription whose Topic Filter matches the Topic Name attached to an Application Message. The topic resource MAY be either predefined in the Server by an administrator or it MAY be dynamically created by the Server when it receives the first subscription or an Application Message with that Topic Name. The Server MAY also use a security component to selectively authorize actions on the topic resource for a given Client.
requirements.condition: When an Application Message's Topic Name matches a Client Subscription Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: Send the Application Message to that matching Client Subscription.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not omit a matching subscription from routing.
requirements.why_checkable: Known subscription filters can be matched and per-subscription delivery observed.

requirements.quote: An Application Message is sent to each Client Subscription whose Topic Filter matches the Topic Name attached to an Application Message. The topic resource MAY be either predefined in the Server by an administrator or it MAY be dynamically created by the Server when it receives the first subscription or an Application Message with that Topic Name. The Server MAY also use a security component to selectively authorize actions on the topic resource for a given Client.
requirements.condition: For a topic resource
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to have an administrator predefine it.
requirements.why_checkable: MAY grants an optional provisioning method without requiring it.

requirements.quote: An Application Message is sent to each Client Subscription whose Topic Filter matches the Topic Name attached to an Application Message. The topic resource MAY be either predefined in the Server by an administrator or it MAY be dynamically created by the Server when it receives the first subscription or an Application Message with that Topic Name. The Server MAY also use a security component to selectively authorize actions on the topic resource for a given Client.
requirements.condition: On the first subscription or first Application Message using a Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to create the topic resource dynamically.
requirements.why_checkable: MAY grants optional dynamic creation without requiring that implementation model.

requirements.quote: An Application Message is sent to each Client Subscription whose Topic Filter matches the Topic Name attached to an Application Message. The topic resource MAY be either predefined in the Server by an administrator or it MAY be dynamically created by the Server when it receives the first subscription or an Application Message with that Topic Name. The Server MAY also use a security component to selectively authorize actions on the topic resource for a given Client.
requirements.condition: When authorizing a Client action on a topic resource
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to use a security component for selective authorization.
requirements.why_checkable: MAY grants an optional security architecture without imposing a required check or decision.

requirements.quote: Unless stated otherwise, if either the Server or Client encounters a protocol violation, it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet which caused the protocol violation [MQTT-4.8.0-1].
requirements.condition: Unless another rule states otherwise, when the Server encounters a protocol violation in a received Control Packet
requirements.error_behavior: Close the same Network Connection on which the offending packet arrived.
requirements.why_checkable: A malformed packet can be injected on one of multiple connections and the closed connection identified.

requirements.quote: Unless stated otherwise, if either the Server or Client encounters a protocol violation, it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet which caused the protocol violation [MQTT-4.8.0-1].
requirements.condition: Unless another rule states otherwise, when the Client encounters a protocol violation in a received Control Packet
requirements.error_behavior: Close the same Network Connection on which the offending packet arrived.
requirements.why_checkable: A malformed packet can be injected and Client connection termination observed.

requirements.quote: If the Client or Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet [MQTT-4.8.0-2]. If a Server detects a Transient Error it SHOULD NOT disconnect or have any other effect on its interactions with any other Client.
requirements.condition: When the Client encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet
requirements.error_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which that packet arrived.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled processing failure can be induced and Client connection closure observed.

requirements.quote: If the Client or Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet [MQTT-4.8.0-2]. If a Server detects a Transient Error it SHOULD NOT disconnect or have any other effect on its interactions with any other Client.
requirements.condition: When the Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet
requirements.error_behavior: Close the Network Connection on which that packet arrived.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled per-connection processing failure can identify which connection closes.

requirements.quote: If the Client or Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet [MQTT-4.8.0-2]. If a Server detects a Transient Error it SHOULD NOT disconnect or have any other effect on its interactions with any other Client.
requirements.condition: When the Server detects a Transient Error affecting one Client
requirements.required_behavior: Keep every other Client connected.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server SHOULD NOT disconnect another Client.
requirements.why_checkable: Multiple Clients can remain connected while an error is injected on only one connection.

requirements.quote: If the Client or Server encounters a Transient Error while processing an inbound Control Packet it MUST close the Network Connection on which it received that Control Packet [MQTT-4.8.0-2]. If a Server detects a Transient Error it SHOULD NOT disconnect or have any other effect on its interactions with any other Client.
requirements.condition: When the Server detects a Transient Error affecting one Client
requirements.required_behavior: Preserve its interactions with every other Client.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server SHOULD NOT let the error otherwise affect another Client's interactions.
requirements.why_checkable: Traffic and protocol state for unaffected Clients can be compared before and after the injected error.

requirements.quote: This Chapter is provided for guidance only and is Non Normative. However, it is strongly recommended that Server implementations that offer TLS [RFC5246] SHOULD use TCP port 8883 (IANA service name: secure-mqtt).
requirements.condition: When a Server implementation offers TLS
requirements.required_behavior: Use TCP port 8883.
requirements.why_checkable: The statement is explicitly within a guidance-only Non Normative chapter and therefore is not an implementation conformance constraint.
